Services

What I Do

I build the full social media and performance marketing system behind a growing brand — from positioning and content direction to paid acquisition, optimization and reporting.

My role is not only to launch ads. I research the audience, map the funnel, develop the creative direction, structure campaigns, test audiences and messages, track the numbers, optimize budgets and scale what actually works.

From strategy to execution, I manage the full social media and performance marketing cycle: content planning, campaign setup, audience targeting, creative testing, retargeting, optimization and reporting. The goal is simple — build a stronger presence, reach the right people and turn media spend into measurable growth.

Beauty & Skincare — Meta Ads Campaign

Explore the campaign like a real client report: objective, audience, strategy, Meta Ads Manager snapshot, performance graph and measurable results.

Meta Ads Campaign

Campaign Objective

Increase brand awareness, drive engagement, and boost online sales for the beauty & skincare brand.

Target Audience

Women 18–45, interested in skincare, beauty, wellness, self-care and related purchase behaviors.

Strategy

  • Creative strategy with high-quality visuals & short videos
  • Meta Ads across Facebook & Instagram placements
  • A/B testing for creatives & audience segments
  • Retargeting website visitors & engaged users
  • Budget optimization toward the strongest ad sets

THE ADVIRA TEAM

Different Specialists. One Growth Team.

An integrated marketing team is built around the brand’s goals—not a fixed headcount. A typical full-service setup can draw on 8–12 specialist functions, with roles combined or added depending on the scope of work.

HOW WE WORK

One connected process, from first idea to measurable improvement.

Strategy, content, creators, paid media, e-commerce and analytics work as one connected system. The exact team mix is tailored to each project, so every specialist has a clear role and the work stays focused on business outcomes.

BUILT AROUND YOUR GOALS

The right mix of skills for each project.

These are specialist functions—not a claim that every project needs 15 separate full-time people. Some functions may be combined, while creator production or technical support can be brought in when needed. The team structure is shaped around your goals, budget and campaign scope.
